items.markdown:
Zayin (ז) is the `seventh letter of the Hebrew alphabet` , pronounced like the "z" in "zebra".[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Zayin/zayin.html)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zayin)

### Basic Details

- **Pronunciation:** /z/ (voiced alveolar fricative)
- **Numerical Value (Gematria):** 7
- **Origin/Meaning:** Literally means "sword", "weapon," or an ancient agricultural tool/plow derived from roots meaning to nourish or sustain (like *mazon* , food).
- **Shape:** Resembles a vertical line (like the letter *Vav* ) with a "crown" or crossbar on top. Mystically, it is seen as a *Vav* crowned.[[1]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137079/jewish/Zayin.htm)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zayin)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/is59WJsPsok)[[4]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Zayin/zayin.html)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r1zj0Ead5R4&t=16)[[6]](https://www.ancient-hebrew.org/ancient-alphabet/zayin.htm)[[7]](https://hebrewtoday.com/alphabet/the-letter-zine-%D7%96/)[[8]](https://inner.org/hebleter/zayin.htm)

### Spiritual and Symbolic Significance

- **The Number Seven:** Associated with completeness, perfection, the Sabbath (Shabbat), the Sabbatical year (Shmita), and divine order.
- **Returning Light (*Ohr Hozer*):** In Jewish mysticism taught on platforms like [Chabad.org](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137079/jewish/Zayin.htm) , the preceding letter *Vav* represents the straight light descending from God, while *Zayin* represents the returning light ascending back to the source.
- **A Weapon of Spirit:** The sword shape represents spiritual struggle, defense of divine principles, and the active power of God's word.
- **Remembrance:** It connects to the concept of memory (*zain/zchor*).[[1]](https://gabrielelevy.com/pages/the-letter-zayn)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137079/jewish/Zayin.htm)[[3]](https://hebrewtoday.com/alphabet/the-letter-zine-%D7%96/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/is59WJsPsok)[[5]](https://inner.org/hebleter/zayin.htm)[[6]](https://www.7dorim.com/en/articles/articles-the-power-of-hebrew-letters/the-power-of-zayin-%D7%96/)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r1zj0Ead5R4&t=16)[[8]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Zayin/zayin.html)
